commands.title: Keep awake state
commands.description: Whether the Mac is kept awake and why: {on, text, detail, manual, until, holds: [{id, kind, label, until?, pid?, session?, workspace?}], agents, battery, display}. Every change publishes awake.changed with the same shape. Show text and detail as they are.

on.description: The Mac is kept awake now.

text.description: What to show while on, e.g. Awake until 18:30; empty when off.

detail.description: One sentence: what holds it, battery, screen, lid.

manual.description: The user's own hold is on.

until.description: Unix seconds when the user's hold ends; 0 when off or without an end.
Unix seconds when it ends, if it does.

battery.description: The rule holds on battery too.

commands.title: Set keep awake
commands.description: Turn the user's own keep-awake hold on (for minutes, or until turned off when minutes is 0 or absent) or off. Returns the state as awake.state does.

on.description: Turn the hold on or off.

minutes.description: How long; 0 or absent: until turned off.

commands.title: Keep Mac awake
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake until you turn it off.

commands.title: Let Mac sleep
commands.description: End your keep-awake hold; agent holds and the while-agents-work rule stay.

commands.title: Hold the Mac awake
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake for a long build or run, then release it with awake.release. The hold ends by itself after minutes (default 60, at most 720), when the process pid exits, or when your session closes. Returns {hold, until}.

reason.description: What runs, shown to the user, e.g. release build.

pid.description: End the hold when this process exits.

until.description: Unix seconds when it ends at the latest.

commands.title: Release the Mac
commands.description: End a hold made with awake.hold.

commands.title: Set keep awake settings
commands.description: Change the keep-awake settings; returns the state as awake.state does.

agents.description: Keep the Mac awake while any agent session is active.

battery.description: That rule holds on battery too.
